record_type_quote: The present study examined the latent factor structure of the PTCI and PTCI-9 in a sample of 185 treatment-seeking outpatients with traumatic stress symptoms to replicate and extend initial findings on the psychometric properties of the PTCI-9.

targets.evidence_quote: Recently, a nine-item abbreviated version was developed (PTCI-9; Wells et al., 2019), which may be a reliable alternative with improved model fit. The present study examined the latent factor structure of the PTCI and PTCI-9 in a sample of 185 treatment-seeking outpatients with traumatic stress symptoms to replicate and extend initial findings on the psychometric properties of the PTCI-9.
targets.outcome_quote: The present study replicated previous findings that the PTCI-9 may be a psychometrically sound alternative for measuring trauma-related cognitions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall replication verdict in abstract.
